owner_creation.analysis: table_size: The c_int owns allocated table capacity, initialized zero and assigned sc_height only after a successful ecalloc return.
owner_creation.invariant: Capacity records storage size rather than current screen rows.
limitations: Source-level growth/fatal-cleanup ordering concern is recorded under existing M0-MEM-001; no new runtime proof or fix is claimed. M0-MEM-003 and IND-POS-F4 remain open.

aliases_escapes.analysis: table_size: pos_init reads it by value to choose reuse versus growth; no external pointer to the field escapes, but its meaning depends on the live table owner.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A capacity number alone cannot validate a table address.
limitations: Source-level growth/fatal-cleanup ordering concern is recorded under existing M0-MEM-001; no new runtime proof or fix is claimed. M0-MEM-003 and IND-POS-F4 remain open.

callback_targets.analysis: table_size: No callback is stored; the allocation selected by the capacity comparison may invoke fatal cleanup before the next value is assigned.

invalidation.analysis: table_size: Shrink retains capacity and changes table_rows; growth frees the old array while the old capacity value remains published until replacement succeeds.

mutation_commit.analysis: table_size: The successful branch commits table, then table_size and table_rows; failure between old free and new assignment leaves stale capacity/pointer association.
